original_thesis: Revenue compounds through recurring contracts while gross margin expands.
developments: Q2 renewal rate was 94%.
Gross margin rose from 61% to 64% year over year.

original_thesis: A regulated utility can fund its dividend from stable operating cash flow.
developments: Quarterly operating cash flow was unchanged.
The rate case has not yet been decided.

original_thesis: Pricing power and operating leverage will expand margins.
developments: Revenue grew 8% but gross margin fell 500 basis points after discounting increased.

original_thesis: A clean balance sheet gives the company time to complete its product launch.
developments: The lender declared a covenant breach and can demand repayment.
Management cancelled the product launch.

original_thesis: Demand will grow as a new distribution channel opens.
developments: A blog claims the channel launched but provides no company filing, date, or sales data.

original_thesis: Market share gains will offset a mature market.
developments: Management says share rose two points.
An undated industry summary says share fell three points and names no methodology.

original_thesis: Low inventory supports pricing through the next quarter.
developments: The only inventory report is dated eighteen months before the stated facts-as-of date.

original_thesis: A patent protects a high-margin franchise.
developments: A court invalidated the only patent named in the original thesis.

original_thesis: The fund supplies diversified broad-market exposure at low cost.
developments: The top ten holdings now represent 58% of assets, versus 22% in the original disclosure.

original_thesis: A short-duration fund preserves capital while rates remain uncertain.
developments: The disclosed duration remains 0.2 years.
The fund reduced its expense ratio.

original_thesis: A factory expansion can be funded from existing cash and should relieve capacity constraints.
developments: Construction was delayed six months.
Management issued new shares at a discount to fund the project.

original_thesis: A subscription product has durable retention and improving unit economics.
developments: Net revenue retention fell from 112% to 96%.
Customer acquisition cost increased 40%.

original_thesis: An acquisition can add customers without impairing the balance sheet.
developments: The acquisition has been announced but no purchase price, financing terms, or closing date has been disclosed.

original_thesis: The fund provides a diversifying bond allocation with investment-grade credit quality.
developments: The latest holdings report still shows 99% investment-grade bonds.

original_thesis: A management turnaround will reduce costs without damaging service quality.
developments: Operating expense fell 12%.
Customer churn rose from 4% to 11%.

original_thesis: A commodity producer benefits from lower extraction costs.
developments: Management says unit costs improved.
No production volume, cost table, or independent report is supplied.

original_thesis: New regulation will permit a profitable product launch.
developments: The agency's final rule expressly prohibits the proposed product in the company's target market.

original_thesis: The fund tracks its index closely and is appropriate as a low-turnover core holding.
developments: Twelve-month tracking difference was 0.03%.
Portfolio turnover was 4%.

original_thesis: A concentration of government customers is acceptable because contracts are renewing.
developments: The largest customer, representing 46% of revenue, gave notice that it will not renew.

original_thesis: The fund is a liquid inflation hedge with transparent commodity exposure.
developments: The provider published daily holdings and the fund's average daily volume increased 35%.
